name: Specialized
verdict: Specialized Bicycle Components is controlled by its founder Mike Sinyard; the listed Taiwanese bicycle maker Merida owns 35%. Nothing found.
note: US bike manufacturer; premium partner of Team SD Worx-Protime (team partners page) and kit supplier of Red Bull-BORA-hansgrohe. Rating note (issue #603, 2026-09-29): founder-controlled, with 35% held by the listed Taiwanese bicycle maker Merida; Merida's own shareholders weren't checked (a state would need about 14.3% of Merida to reach 5% of Specialized). No human-rights finding found.
